_comment: Template for the Ethereum mainnet deployment. The auction values are the decided launch settings (checklists/1-pre-deploy.md); on chain 1 script/DeployKilim.s.sol refuses any other value, any deployer but the artist's wallet, a skipped nonce check and a zero minLeadSeconds. Copy it, fill every TODO, get it signed off, then follow checklists/2-deploy.md and docs/STORAGE.md. The stores come from onchain/pack_motifs.py and onchain/pack_page.py once the motifs and the page are final. The `expected` block names the content by hash (five section hashes, the two tokenURI goldens, and the sha256 of the artist's page, the artwork, the still and the loader) and the texts (`texts`: the hash of the collection, 1/1 and bazaar texts, script/KilimTexts.sol): print it with `pnpm -s expected --config <this file>` from the packed stores, compare it with the published values, and paste it in. On chain 1 the script refuses a config without it, a zero in it, a store or a text that differs from it, and an artwork that never reads KILIM_GRIDS. deploy/mainnet.json adds the bazaar block, whose texts `texts` covers too.
deployerNonce: TODO: the published nonce for the motif collection, the first of the three contract transactions
minLeadSeconds: TODO: the inspection window in seconds, nonzero (600, decided 12 October 2026: the registration phase is the window)

auction.startsAt: TODO: unix seconds; 0 until the day (runStore ignores it, runContracts refuses it), then right before runContracts the time now + 1200

collection.description: TODO: the collection description, exactly as packed (build-motifs/manifest.json description)

oneOfOne.name: The Unwoven Kilim
oneOfOne.description: TODO: the 1/1 description, exactly as packed (build-page/manifest.json description)
oneOfOne.externalUrl: TODO: the 1/1 external url, exactly as packed (build-page/manifest.json externalUrl)
